get_spacy_negative: generate a negative caption by swapping noun phrases, adjectives, and verbs in input text using spacy
get_antonyms: find antonyms for a given phrase using NLTK wordnet synsets and lemmas
levenshtein_distance: calculate the edit distance between two strings using dynamic programming
different_enough: check if two strings are sufficiently different based on normalized Levenshtein distance threshold
process_swaps_single_pass: swap text segments at specified index pairs in a single pass to produce modified text
